name: Bay Runner Low
description: Low-profile runner for daily pavement miles, on a soft nitrogen-infused midsole.
longDescription: The Bay Runner Low is a low-profile runner made for daily miles on pavement. Long easy efforts where comfort matters more than speed, so the foam stays soft from the first mile to the last. The upper uses engineered mesh, and the shoe is finished with a nitrogen-infused midsole. Weighs 9.4 oz with a 8 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Oakland Cruiser
description: Court-style low top in leather, cushioned for all-day city walking.
longDescription: The Oakland Cruiser is a court-style low top made for walking the city all day. Built for hours on hard concrete, with a footbed that keeps its shape after a full day on your feet. The upper uses full-grain leather, and the shoe is finished with a cushioned ortholite footbed. Weighs 12.1 oz with a 6 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Mission Mids
description: Mid-top skate shoe in heavy canvas, with a reinforced ollie patch.
longDescription: The Mission Mids is a mid-top skate shoe made for skatepark sessions. Board feel is the point, so the sole stays thin and the stitching is doubled where grip tape chews through other shoes. The upper uses heavy canvas, and the shoe is finished with a reinforced ollie patch. Weighs 13.6 oz with a 4 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Embarcadero Knit
description: Sock-fit knit trainer for gym circuits and light runs.
longDescription: The Embarcadero Knit is a sock-fit knit trainer made for gym circuits and light runs. It bends with the foot instead of fighting it, which keeps transitions smooth when you move between stations. The upper uses recycled knit, and the shoe is finished with a one-piece knit upper that flexes with the foot. Weighs 7.8 oz with a 8 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Telegraph Trail
description: Trail runner with a 4 mm lugged outsole that bites into loose dirt.
longDescription: The Telegraph Trail is a trail runner made for muddy singletrack and fire roads. Lugs are spaced to shed mud rather than pack it, and the toe bumper takes hits from roots and rocks. The upper uses ripstop mesh, and the shoe is finished with a 4 mm lugged outsole that bites loose dirt. Weighs 11.2 oz with a 6 mm heel-to-toe drop, stability support, and a water-resistant construction.

name: Lake Merritt Glide
description: Everyday walking sneaker with a rocker sole that rolls you forward.
longDescription: The Lake Merritt Glide is a everyday walking sneaker made for errands and long strolls. A gentle rocker keeps the stride rolling so long walks feel shorter than they are. The upper uses suede and mesh, and the shoe is finished with a rocker sole that rolls you forward. Weighs 8.9 oz with a 10 mm heel-to-toe drop, cushioned support, and a breathable construction.

name: Fog City High
description: High-top in nubuck leather with a fleece-lined collar for cold mornings.
longDescription: The Fog City High is a high-top lifestyle sneaker made for cold mornings and layered fits. The collar sits above the ankle bone for a little warmth and a lot of silhouette. The upper uses nubuck leather, and the shoe is finished with a fleece-lined collar. Weighs 14.0 oz with a 4 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a water-resistant construction.

name: Broadway Court
description: Classic leather tennis shoe on a low-profile cup sole.
longDescription: The Broadway Court is a classic tennis shoe made for the office and the weekend. Quiet enough for a workday and clean enough that it never looks out of place after hours. The upper uses smooth leather, and the shoe is finished with a low-profile cup sole that stays clean. Weighs 12.8 oz with a 6 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Alameda Deck
description: Boat-style canvas slip-on with a siped outsole for wet surfaces.
longDescription: The Alameda Deck is a boat-style canvas slip-on made for the dock and the beach. Quick to slip on, quick to rinse off, and it grips wet fiberglass better than bare rubber. The upper uses washed canvas, and the shoe is finished with a siped outsole for wet surfaces. Weighs 9.8 oz with a 5 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a water-resistant construction.

name: Richmond Racer
description: Lightweight road racer with a nylon plate that stiffens the toe-off.
longDescription: The Richmond Racer is a lightweight road racer made for tempo runs and race day. Stiff under the toes for a snappy toe-off, light enough that you forget it is there. The upper uses mono mesh, and the shoe is finished with a nylon plate that stiffens the toe-off. Weighs 6.9 oz with a 8 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Dolores Skate
description: Vulcanized skate low top on gum rubber, with deep tread and a suede toe cap.
longDescription: The Dolores Skate is a vulcanized skate low top made for street skating and cruising. Vulcanized construction keeps board feel intact while the gum rubber holds grip on ledges and ramps. The upper uses suede toe cap, and the shoe is finished with a gum rubber sole with deep tread. Weighs 12.4 oz with a 4 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Piedmont Peak
description: Hiking sneaker in water-resistant leather with a grit-blocking gusseted tongue.
longDescription: The Piedmont Peak is a hiking sneaker made for day hikes with a light pack. Enough underfoot for gravel and roots, with a collar that seals out dust on dry trails. The upper uses water-resistant leather, and the shoe is finished with a gusseted tongue that keeps grit out. Weighs 13.2 oz with a 10 mm heel-to-toe drop, stability support, and a water-resistant construction.

name: Jack London Boot
description: Mid-cut winter sneaker in oiled leather, sealed at the seams to shed water.
longDescription: The Jack London Boot is a mid-cut winter sneaker made for rainy commutes. Sealed seams and a water-shedding upper mean puddles are an inconvenience, not a soaking. The upper uses oiled leather, and the shoe is finished with a sealed seam construction that sheds water. Weighs 15.1 oz with a 8 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a water-resistant construction.

name: Sunset Slip-On
description: Laceless knit slip-on with an elastic gore panel that holds the foot.
longDescription: The Sunset Slip-On is a laceless knit slip-on made for throwing on and heading out. No laces to tie, a panel that stays put, and a shape that works with everything in the closet. The upper uses stretch knit, and the shoe is finished with an elastic gore panel that holds the foot. Weighs 6.4 oz with a 6 mm heel-to-toe drop, cushioned support, and a breathable construction.

name: Bayview Boost
description: Cushioned max-stack trainer built for standing all day.
longDescription: The Bayview Boost is a cushioned max-stack trainer made for standing all day at work. The stack is deep and wide, which spreads pressure instead of concentrating it in the heel. The upper uses double-jacquard mesh, and the shoe is finished with a tall foam stack that absorbs impact. Weighs 10.8 oz with a 12 mm heel-to-toe drop, cushioned support, and a breathable construction.

name: Marina Mesh
description: Breezy summer trainer in single-layer mesh with an open weave.
longDescription: The Marina Mesh is a breezy summer trainer made for hot afternoons near the water. Air moves through the upper while the sole stays light, so the shoe never turns into a sauna. The upper uses single-layer mesh, and the shoe is finished with an open mesh weave that moves air. Weighs 7.2 oz with a 8 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Temescal Trainer
description: Cross-training shoe with a wide flat heel for stable lifting.
longDescription: The Temescal Trainer is a cross-training shoe made for lifting and short conditioning work. A broad, flat platform under the heel keeps lifts steady while the forefoot stays flexible for conditioning. The upper uses abrasion-resistant textile, and the shoe is finished with a wide flat heel for stable lifts. Weighs 11.6 oz with a 4 mm heel-to-toe drop, stability support, and a breathable construction.

name: Coliseum Classic
description: Retro basketball high top in patent leather with a padded ankle collar.
longDescription: The Coliseum Classic is a retro basketball high top made for hardwood, old school. High cut, heavy sole, and a look that has never really gone out of style on a court. The upper uses patent leather, and the shoe is finished with a padded ankle collar for support. Weighs 14.6 oz with a 6 mm heel-to-toe drop, stability support, and a breathable construction.

name: Berkeley Bounce
description: Responsive foam daily trainer with rocker geometry for quick turnover.
longDescription: The Berkeley Bounce is a responsive foam daily trainer made for everyday runs. Foam returns energy on toe-off instead of absorbing it, so steady paces feel easier than they should. The upper uses circular-knit upper, and the shoe is finished with a rocker geometry that keeps turnover quick. Weighs 9.1 oz with a 8 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Sausalito Stroll
description: Casual organic-canvas low top that packs flat for travel.
longDescription: The Sausalito Stroll is a casual canvas low top made for weekend wandering. Soft canvas, a flexible sole, and enough structure to walk a few miles without complaint. The upper uses organic canvas, and the shoe is finished with a flexible sole that packs flat for travel. Weighs 8.2 oz with a 5 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Fruitvale Flyer
description: Street runner with a forefoot rubber pod for grip on turns.
longDescription: The Fruitvale Flyer is a street running shoe made for quick sprints and pickup games. Traction is placed where turns happen, so the shoe holds when you cut hard. The upper uses mesh with synthetic overlays, and the shoe is finished with a forefoot rubber pod for traction on turns. Weighs 9.6 oz with a 8 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Golden Gate Grip
description: All-terrain hybrid built to go from trailhead to pavement.
longDescription: The Golden Gate Grip is a all-terrain hybrid made for trailheads that turn into pavement. One outsole that handles dirt and asphalt, so you do not have to change shoes mid-route. The upper uses durable ripstop, and the shoe is finished with a multi-directional lug pattern. Weighs 11.9 oz with a 6 mm heel-to-toe drop, stability support, and a water-resistant construction.

name: Rockridge Runner
description: Neutral road trainer with a dual-density midsole that firms up underfoot.
longDescription: The Rockridge Runner is a neutral road trainer made for a mix of easy and steady miles. The midsole firms where you push and softens where you cruise, which suits a varied week. The upper uses engineered mesh, and the shoe is finished with a dual-density midsole that firms up underfoot. Weighs 9.9 oz with a 10 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Hayward Hustle
description: Budget trainer in synthetic leather, built for the gym and the errands.
longDescription: The Hayward Hustle is a budget trainer made for the gym, the walk, the errands. Simple, tough, and cheap to replace, which is exactly what a daily shoe should be. The upper uses synthetic leather, and the shoe is finished with a durable outsole built to take abuse. Weighs 10.4 oz with a 8 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.

name: Skyline Sprint
description: Track-inspired racing flat with a spiked-look rubber plate for grip.
longDescription: The Skyline Sprint is a track-inspired racing flat made for fast intervals on the roads. Light and stiff with just enough cushioning to survive a hard session on asphalt. The upper uses perforated mesh, and the shoe is finished with a spiked-look rubber plate for grip. Weighs 6.2 oz with a 6 mm heel-to-toe drop, neutral support, and a breathable construction.
